text: こんな　うわさが…　キクコは　わかい　とき　オーキドはかせと　ライバルで　つよさを　きそって　いたらしい！

structure.jp: オーキドはかせと　ライバルで
structure.en: was rivals with Professor Oak, and

structure.jp: つよさを　きそって　いたらしい！

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.span: きそって　いたらしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says this is what you have heard, not something you know for sure. きそって　いたらしい = 'apparently they used to compete'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いる says something goes on over a stretch of time, and いた puts it in the past. きそって　いた = 'were competing'.

patterns.name: 〜で (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is the 'is, and' form of だ, joining this part to what comes next. ライバルで = 'were rivals, and'.
